title: Add admin-only persistent editable text labels under TSIC Logger ID buttons

requirements.summary: Display admin-only editable text input fields under each TSIC Logger ID button that show and allow editing of persistent labels
acceptanceCriteria: Each ID button on the TSIC Loggers page has an editable text field rendered below it, visible only when useIsCallerAdmin returns true.
For non-admin users, neither the text field nor any label text appears in the rendered DOM.
Admin users can type in the field and save the label; the saved value persists after a page reload.
The frontend only fetches label data after confirming admin status; the fetch is not initiated for non-admin sessions.
Label data is never present in the JS bundle state or React component tree for non-admin users.

file_operations.description: Add editable text input fields below each TSIC Logger ID button that are only rendered when useIsCallerAdmin returns true. The input shows the saved label for that ID and allows admin users to edit and save it. For non-admin users, do not render the label field or any label data into the DOM. Use the useTSICLabels hook to fetch label data only when admin status is confirmed, and the mutation hook to save label changes. Include inline save/edit UI controls (e.g., edit icon, save button) that appear only for admins. Ensure the component does not fetch or display label data for non-admin sessions.

requirements.summary: Create React Query hooks for fetching and saving TSIC ID labels, callable only by admin users
acceptanceCriteria: useTSICLabels hook fetches labels only when isAdmin is true.
A mutation function allows saving a label by ID and invalidates the labels query on success.
Hooks follow the same pattern as existing hooks (useGoogleSheetsDownloadLink, useIsCallerAdmin).

file_operations.description: Create a React Query hook that fetches all TSIC ID labels from the backend getAllLoggerLabels function, returning a map of bigint ID to string label. The hook must only fetch data when the caller is confirmed as an admin (use useIsCallerAdmin hook to check). Also export a mutation hook (e.g., useSetLoggerLabel) that calls the backend setLoggerIdLabel function to save a label for a given ID, and invalidates the labels query on success. Follow the existing pattern used in useGoogleSheetsDownloadLink and useIsCallerAdmin, and ensure the query is disabled when the user is not an admin.
